page.overview:
Who is Frozen Yogurt Princess?

Frozen Yogurt Princess resembles frozen yogurt. Her hair is frozen yogurt in a bun. Her dress is an upside down ice cream cone. She has similarities to both Flame Princess and Princess Bubblegum, as stated by Jake.

Her hair style is almost identical to that of Flame Princess, and her dress also shares quite a few similarities, as well as having her unique thick arms. She also has a small blue gem on her forehead, which also resembles Flame Princess, who has a red/orange gem on her forehead.

Her resemblance to Princess Bubblegum is likely the fact that they are both dessert/sugary foods. Her neck shape somehow resembles hers, as well as her legs. Her personality also resembles Princess Bubblegum more than Flame Princess. Frozen Yogurt Princess also has a blue gem, similar to the gem in Princess Bubblegum's crown.
